configurePresets.name: debug-og
configurePresets.description: Debug at -Og: keeps -g and asserts but drops the -O0 slowdown on compute-heavy tests. This is also the toolchain default for any Debug build now, so this preset only spells it out explicitly.

configurePresets.name: lib-release
configurePresets.description: Library-only build (no tests/examples) at the native baseline, shared by the binding jobs. Build type defaults to Release. CI overrides TREEWEAVE_ARCH per platform with a portable baseline; local builds get -march=native.

configurePresets.name: ci-linux-debug
configurePresets.description: Plain -Og Debug: full build + test suite, no runtime sanitizers. Used by the GCC Debug rows (compiler-portability coverage); GCC+ASan instrumentation of the template-heavy eval TUs exhausts the hosted runner's memory.

configurePresets.name: ci-linux-debug-asan
configurePresets.description: ci-linux-debug + ASan/UBSan. Used by the clang Debug rows only, because clang's sanitizer instrumentation compiles the same TUs in a fraction of GCC's time/memory.

configurePresets.name: ci-windows
configurePresets.description: MSVC (cl.exe) via Ninja, not the Visual Studio generator: Ninja is much faster and matches every other platform's single-config flow. Needs the MSVC environment (setup-cpp vcvarsall) on PATH so CMake finds cl.exe.

configurePresets.name: ci-windows-clang
configurePresets.description: clang-cl via Ninja for compile + test coverage of the Windows clang path. dev_helpers.cmake drops -Werror under clang-cl (its driver enables an -Weverything-family set the plain clang driver does not), so this row verifies the code compiles and the tests pass; warning hygiene is enforced under -Werror by the Linux clang rows. Needs the MSVC environment (setup-cpp vcvarsall) on PATH.

configurePresets.name: coverage
configurePresets.description: Debug + --coverage. Runs at the -Og toolchain default rather than -O0: line attribution is slightly coarser where the optimizer inlines, in exchange for an instrumented run that is not the slowest job in CI. Pass -DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_DEBUG='-O0 -g' to get the strictest line data back.

configurePresets.name: valgrind
configurePresets.description: Single-arch (multiarch off by default) so valgrind never has to execute the AVX-512 dispatch variant it can't handle.

configurePresets.name: multiarch
configurePresets.displayName: Multiarch dispatch (x86-64 baseline + runtime ISA select)
configurePresets.description: TREEWEAVE_ARCH=x86-64 (not v3): the dispatcher builds every ISA variant and picks one at runtime, so the compile baseline must be the lowest.

configurePresets.name: multiarch-arm
configurePresets.displayName: Multiarch dispatch (aarch64 armv8-a baseline + runtime ISA select)
configurePresets.description: aarch64 counterpart of multiarch: TREEWEAVE_ARCH=armv8-a so the compile baseline is the portable ARMv8-A level; the dispatcher selects the single mandatory neon64 variant at runtime (SVE excluded by design).

configurePresets.name: codspeed
configurePresets.description: Instruction-count perf bench for CodSpeed CI. x86-64-v3 (AVX2) baseline is deliberate: CodSpeed `simulation` runs the binary under Valgrind/Cachegrind, which handles AVX2 but not AVX-512, same constraint as the `valgrind` preset. RelWithDebInfo keeps the debug symbols CodSpeed needs for meaningful reports.

configurePresets.name: bindings-base
configurePresets.description: Common settings for every language binding. IPO is on here and off in lib-release: a binding ships one shared artifact and no static archive, so link-time optimization pays and no consumer ever links compiler IL.

configurePresets.name: bindings-matlab
configurePresets.description: Builds the MEX entirely from CMake: fetches the mwrap generator via CPM, generates the gateway + bz_*.m from treeweave.mw, and compiles/links treeweave_c_static via matlab_add_mex (MATLAB) and/or mkoctfile (Octave).

configurePresets.name: bindings-octave
configurePresets.description: License-free CI path. Inherits bindings-matlab (same TREEWEAVE_BUILD_MATLAB=ON flag; there is no separate Octave flag). Backend selection is automatic inside bindings/matlab/CMakeLists.txt: if mkoctfile is found it builds treeweave_mex.mex via mkoctfile; if MATLAB is also found it builds treeweave_mex.mexa64 in addition. Use this preset when only Octave/mkoctfile is present (no MATLAB license needed).

configurePresets.name: bindings-js
configurePresets.description: Builds the native Node-API .node addon (links treeweave_c_static) plus the TypeScript layer, and registers the node:test suite. Run 'npm install' in bindings/js first so node-addon-api headers and tsc are present.

configurePresets.name: bindings-js-wasm
configurePresets.description: Builds the same C ABI to a WASM module for the browser backend. Needs the Emscripten SDK on PATH with EMSDK set (e.g. via mymindstorm/setup-emsdk); the toolchain file is resolved from $EMSDK. TREEWEAVE_ARCH is cleared because emcc rejects -march (the toolchain enables -msimd128 instead). Build the treeweave_wasm + treeweave_js_ts targets (not ALL, because the SHARED treeweave_c isn't meaningful under emcc). IPO returns to OFF here: emcc pays the link-time cost and gains no eval throughput.
